title: Make-Up Hours on Work Conditioning and Work Hardening Program Days
content:
# Make-up hours

Questions and answers for therapists running the hour-billed programs of the Workers' Compensation Referral (Work Conditioning Program and Work Hardening Program).

**What are make-up hours?** Hours added to a program day for missed program days. Make-up hours added to the day are two (2) where two or more missed program days with dates of service in the last month have been reported to the adjuster, one (1) where exactly one has, and none otherwise.

**Which missed days count?** Missed program days — late cancellations and no-shows — that have been reported to the adjuster on the referral and whose dates of service fall in the last month. A missed day that has not been reported to the adjuster, or whose date of service is older than the last month, does not count.

**How many hours for each count?**

| Missed program days reported, dates of service in the last month | Make-up hours added |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 or more | 2 |

**Does a third reported missed day add a third hour?** No. Two or more reported missed days add two hours.

**Example (hypothetical).** In the last month the worker missed program days on three dates; two of them have been reported to the adjuster and one has not. Two reported missed days count, and two make-up hours are added to the day.
